create_console_channel: create a ConsoleChannel to print training metrics and loss to the console
create_file_channel: create a FileChannel to write predictions targets and scores to a TSV file
create_tensorboard_channel: create a TensorBoardChannel to log training loss metrics and model histograms to TensorBoard
report_tensorboard_metrics: report training eval and test stage metrics as scalars and histograms to TensorBoard
export_model_graph: export a PyTorch model graph and embedding visualization to TensorBoard using TensorBoardChannel
